result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. In `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery. This is the same filter the quarterly and latest-purchase-order reports use. The ordering and the zero-count reps are unchanged. I also added a note about cancelled orders to the Javadoc.

I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest='*SalesRep*'` before the Javadoc edit. It finished with no errors, but that pattern may match few or no tests. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case or re-run after the Javadoc edit, which only changes a comment.
